plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/backgrounds/room-54-upstream.png, room-54 operation 2 over operation 1, derived and promoted by tools/art/interiors-plate.mjs at y 170; frame.json beside the candidate). Every rect below was read off that picture.
walkableNote: THE GRAVEL BETWEEN THE RIVER AND THE STAKES: right of the rocks along the river's edge, which runs from the falls down to the front left, and left of the two lines of stakes, so no stake stands in front of him (a stake is plate, and would be drawn behind a man standing just behind it). Stepped down the river's diagonal. His stand beside the man upstream is an authored box (`walkBoxesExtra`), at the stakes' edge.

walkBoxesExtra.note: Beside the man upstream, at the edge of the stakes, clear of every post.

scaling.note: ROOM 54'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad was painted 322 tall (in plate pixels) with his feet at y 758, and the man upstream 272 at y 486 -- a flatter slope than Room 5's, 0.18 a row: 243 at y 330 and 340 at the bottom of the frame.

entrances.note: Up the river from the bar.
Up the river from the bar (doc 109, UPSTREAM, the way on).

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees, smallest first. THE FALLS is the little waterfall at the back; THE SLUICE, the half-built trough with its board; THE STAKES, the two crossing lines and their notices; THE BEST GROUND, the gravel, under the rest.

DOWNSTREAM.note: Doc 109: back down the river to the bar and the panners.

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object is looked at on a bare click; every way walks.

occlusion.note: Nothing stands nearer the camera than the walk band: the stakes are kept out of it, the sluice is across the river, so every band is plane 0.

props.note: THE SLUICE's board, NOT YET, as its second LOOK reads it: drawn whole and flat across the trough's front (tools/art/gulch-lettering.py), the plate's own board being a slanted plank.

figureLight.note: Errata 265 (Tyler, 2026-11-10, on the Gulch: "I defer to you"). In the Gulch's daylight Thad was the one cool, dark thing on a warm tan ground, apart from the Gulch's own men, who are painted in it. A warm light and nothing else: his coat stays blue and takes the sun.

motion.note: Errata 273: the room's own small motion (engine/render/MotionLayer.ts). Placed by eye on the plate; nothing here waits on a puzzle's flag.
